answer: Put every public artifact in a shared vault and pay identities only to repair a blindly assigned breakage left by a stranger. Payment lands weeks later, only if an unaffiliated user actually uses the repaired artifact successfully, like a falcon returning to a handler it was not trained by. A farm reaching its zenith spawns more shells, but superficial fixes fail under real use, re-enter the vault, and are redrawn blindly, often by its own shells. Each clone therefore multiplies unpaid repair debt instead of income, while one careful repair earns once and stays earned.
